ns2:course.label: Special Study and Investigation
ns2:course.description: Offers opportunity for an individual to study, on or off campus, selected problems, trends, and new developments in education or to conduct specialized investigations for the improvement of instructional programs. Same as HRD 495. 2 or 4 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours.
